core_obligations: The fourth-order conjugated plate symbol has boundary-root configurations whose degeneracies cannot be handled by the usual second-order estimate. The author microlocal boundary Carleman construction under the original complementing conditions yields observability/resolvent control and, after projecting stationary modes, the exact logarithmic energy decay for D(A^n) data.
